# Contributing to react-simplikit

Thank you for your interest in contributing!

## Quick Links

- **[Full Contributing Guide](../docs/core/contributing.md)** — Implementation guidelines, testing, JSDoc
- **[Versioning Policy](../VERSIONING.md)** — Understanding 0.x versioning and changesets
- **[Design Principles](../docs/core/design-principles.md)** — Library philosophy and patterns

## Quick Start

1. Fork and clone the repository
2. Install dependencies: `yarn install`
3. Create a branch following our [branch naming conventions](../docs/core/contributing.md)
4. Implement your changes following [design principles](../docs/core/design-principles.md)
5. Write tests (100% coverage required)
6. Create a changeset: `yarn changeset` (see [versioning guide](../VERSIONING.md))
7. Submit a PR with clear description
